overall: Los Angeles is in the midst of a classic late-June marine layer pattern, with temperatures locked at 62.6°F since around midnight ET (early morning local PDT time) and zero warming velocity. High dewpoints (~57°F) and southwest winds confirm a strong marine influence, with patchy fog expected to persist through mid-morning before partial clearing. Conditions are consistent with seasonal 'June Gloom' suppressing afternoon heating.
